text: Oh God, we ask You in this journey of righteousness and piety, and of deeds that You are pleased with. Oh God, make this journey easy for us, and extend its distance for us. Oh God, You are the companion on the journey and the successor to the family. Oh God, I seek refuge in You from the troubles of the journey, the gloom of the scene, and the bad upheaval in money and family. And when he returns, he says them and adds to them: “Repentant, repentant, worshipers, to our Lord.” Hamdoun
